subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this be fixed narrowly in Telegram plain-group route persistence, by a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or by both in staged PRs?
rationale: The visible source gap is Telegram-specific, but related Mattermost and shared-session reports show adjacent non-direct delivery-context failures where a shared fix could alter cross-channel session routing behavior.

options.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
options.body: Persist last-route metadata for non-forum Telegram groups with live Telegram restart proof, then handle shared fallback separately if still needed.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Refresh or replace the shared fallback PR after compatibility review for non-direct channel session routing.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until maintainers can reproduce the Telegram restart/data-loss path on current main.

recommendation.title: Fix Telegram plain groups first
recommendation.body: Persist last-route metadata for non-forum Telegram groups with live Telegram restart proof, then handle shared fallback separately if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses the shared inbound session recorder and route persistence boundary that steipete introduced and maintained.
